source: Quiz 3 - Sessions 1-4: Model Size, Thinking, and Skills
question: The addendum describes a more recent line of work that studies looping under a specific name. What is that architecture called?

options.feedback: Width -- bigger embeddings and wider matrices -- is the Session 3 lever for model size, not the addendum's line of work on reusing one block.
This is close to the opposite. The architecture in the addendum is defined by unrolling a shared block to an arbitrary depth at inference, not a depth fixed in advance.
The block is shared and unrolled as many times as needed at inference time, so depth becomes something you can spend more of on a hard problem instead of a fixed property of the model.
Projection describes how image understanding gets added to a model pretrained on text, discussed elsewhere in this session, not the looping work in the addendum.
